# OpenSocrates 1.4.0 — Windows candidate

Unpublished candidate; see [Windows support](../../docs/windows-support.md) and [Korean guide](../../docs/windows-support.ko.md). Native Windows x64 packaging, safe installation and manual updates are added. Authenticated delivery and Desktop claims must follow the working record; no clean-machine, ARM64, signing or macOS execution claim is made by local Windows checks.
